steps.title: Radius plate: extrude the plate
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as radius_plate.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XY Plane. Draw a rectangle 60 by 40.

steps.title: Radius plate: R5 corner (slide 9 a)
actions: Fillet: Radius 5, select the top left edge (the one through the thickness). OK.
On the drawing this is dimensioned R5 with one arrowhead, from the centre of the arc.

steps.title: Radius plate: R15 hollow
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the front face. Draw a circle R15 centred on the top right corner.
Finish Sketch. Extrude: Profile = the quarter circle inside the plate, Cut, Through All. OK.

steps.title: Radius plate: R5 blends (slide 9 b)
actions: Fillet: Radius 5, select the two sharp edges where the R15 hollow meets the top and the side. OK. Save.
The edge now runs R5 into R15: the reverse curve of slide 9 (b).
steps.note: Slide 9 shows (a) and (b) as separate sketches with no overall sizes; they are put on one 60 x 40 x 10 plate here so learners can see both.
